description: Rapid Assessment for Road Accidents and Safety is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Uganda Red Cross Society (inactive). This data is about Accident hotspots from Road Traffic Accidents survey/ assessment by Uganda Red Cross Society, Ministry of Health and Uganda Police, 14th July 2020. Coverage: Uganda. The portal files it under the publisher Uganda Red Cross Society (inactive). Its tags are roads. It offers 1 resource(s) in KML. The portal shows 2024-04-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
